retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, three-color composition featuring a central figure silhouetted against a vibrant red circular glow on a black field.
triggerTerms: noir red and black graphic style

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male portrait where the subject is partially obscured by shadows, framed by a large, solid red circular backdrop that bleeds into the subject's skin tones, set against a deep black negative space with right-aligned stacked typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a geometric red circle
High-contrast interplay between deep shadows and saturated red light
Right-aligned text block balancing the central visual weight
Monochromatic black background isolating the primary graphic element
coreInvariants: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red circle acts as the primary visual anchor and light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move down to the hands/clothing details, then shift to the top-right text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central circular graphic and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Red (Circular glow and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and red; high saturation in the red channel.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to Black, Red, and Grey/White

letterConstructionRules: Heavy slab serifs for primary headings
Clean, geometric sans-serif for secondary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy slab serifs and light, italicized sans-serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the primary name.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man in a dark suit, centered against a large, solid red circular glow. The rest of the background must be pure black. Use low-key lighting so the man's features are defined by the red light and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, stacked text in the top right corner. Use a bold slab serif for the top four lines (alternating grey and red) and a small, white italicized sans-serif for the fifth line.

verificationChecks: Is the red circle perfectly centered behind the subject?
Is the background pure black with no gradients?
Is the text right-aligned and stacked in the upper right quadrant?
Does the red light appear to illuminate the subject's skin?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red circle does not have a glow or feathering at the edges.
Verify the text is strictly right-aligned.
Check that the subject's suit blends into the black background.
Confirm the red color is consistent between the circle and the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [A] + Geometric [B] Background + High Contrast [C] Lighting + Stacked [D] Typography
